pattern: backlogit v1.10.1 auto-relocates a task/feature file from .backlogit/queue/ to .backlogit/archive/ immediately on "backlogit move <id> --status done", declaring status: done (terminal relocation), not status: archived. This is distinct from a true archived_status-provenance archive and is exactly the pre-archived-by-location state shipment-reconcile tolerates on safe-close and cascade paths.

P-015 verified fully-covered-root cascade classification (classify_shipment_close_path) correctly selected CASCADE for a shipment whose manifest was exactly [root feature + all its direct child tasks, no more]. The Python classifier module is importable directly via PYTHONPATH from .copilot/installed-plugins/autoharness/autoharness/src even though the autoharness gate CLI has no subcommand exposing it yet -- useful fallback for Ship own Step 6 safe-close/cascade decision.

Implementing multiple TDD units (6 in this case) before the first git add/commit produces one combined commit instead of per-task commits, requiring a post-hoc amend. Recommend committing each unit as soon as its own red/green cycle completes, before starting the next unit's edits.
